cohort: Families with children diagnosed with MT16 or CPM
finding: While obstetric and neonatal complications are common in pregnancies affected by MT16 or CPM, the majority of children demonstrate normal neurodevelopmental outcomes and high HRQOL.
mod_finding: This study found a high rate of cesarean delivery (73.8%) in pregnancies affected by mosaic trisomy 16 (MT16) or confined placental mosaicism (CPM) for trisomy 16, but it does not directly compare different modes of delivery.
